category_title: Non-verbal students with moderate to severe cognitive impairments who respond to modified instrumentation and social reinforcement
scenario_title: Recorder instruction and music reading tasks
minimal_context: Zack is sitting on the floor during a fourth-grade inclusive music class where the students are practicing recorder instruction and music reading tasks.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's look at the music notation and practice playing the notes on the recorder.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Sits on the floor, lacking the fine motor coordination to cover the holes on the recorder or use his tongue to control articulation, and unable to decode the music notation.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Try to cover the holes with your fingers and read the notes.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Appears almost oblivious of what else is going on with the fourth graders, leaning back against a classmate's legs.)

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Swipes the classmate's recorder cleaning stick and starts to play "keep away" with it.)

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Let's look at the music notation and practice playing the notes on the recorder.

STUDENT: (Sits on the floor, lacking the fine motor coordination to cover the holes on the recorder or use his tongue to control articulation, and unable to decode the music notation.)

TUTOR: Try to cover the holes with your fingers and read the notes.

STUDENT: (Appears almost oblivious of what else is going on with the fourth graders, leaning back against a classmate's legs.)

TUTOR: Please focus on your instrument.

STUDENT: (Swipes the classmate's recorder cleaning stick and starts to play "keep away" with it.)

task.content: General recorder instruction and music reading tasks

context.materials: Recorder, recorder cleaning stick, melody bells placed on the floor, color-coded notation
context.social_setting: Inclusive setting with fourth graders and a musically proficient paraprofessional

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: Lacked the fine motor coordination to cover holes on a recorder or use the tongue to control articulation, and did not have the cognitive skills required to decode music notation
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Almost oblivious of what else is going on half the time with the fourth graders

behavior_patterns.condition: Sitting on the floor during a fourth-grade inclusive music class
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Leaned back against a classmate’s legs, swiped her recorder cleaning stick and started to play “keep away” with it
